title: First payment to a supplier we have never paid, so there is no account to compare against
notes: Absence of history is itself a signal and it must not be silence: the company is about to send money to an account with nothing behind it. It is a question, never an accusation, and a new supplier is a normal event.

cfdis.issuerName: Insumos Medicos Escobedo SA de CV

expectedFindings.because: The RFC has no payment history at all, so no account can be corroborated and the first payment is the one that establishes the account.
